results.title: The Complete Guide to React Server Components: Mental Models for 2025 - DEV Community
results.snippet: Every single component was shipping to the client, even the ones that never needed to be interactive. Product descriptions, static headers, footer links - all of it bundled up and sent down the wire, forcing browsers to download, parse, and execute JavaScript that literally just displayed text. Then React Server Components landed, and everything changed.
